primary: Full fixed40; fixed16 and remaining24 reported separately to avoid subset optimism

criteria.no_c: Does normal add substantial PC benefit while preserving/improving SA, Joint and actual visuals on the same trained backbone?
criteria.semantic_response_off: Does the native-request response improve SA/Joint/actual requested process while retaining the direct route PC benefit? Do not adopt it merely because it changes text attention.
criteria.direct_write_off: Does direct physical writing add physical process/PC benefit to the new response, and what semantic/visual cost remains?
criteria.native_physical_query: Does independent physical Q provide actual benefit on this checkpoint? Do not extrapolate infer-only equivalence to a universal architectural claim.
criteria.reasoning_swapped_empty_and_mean: Test content contribution while preserving own image/request and relation priors; distinguish altered content from useful content.

visual_rules: Use literal captions. VP034 requests inflation/stretching, not bursting. VP027 requests a smooth round boule, not necessarily vigorous kneading.
High PC with omitted process, static output or deformed/missing entities does not prove improvement.
Compare matched historical videos and same-weight control videos; sampled frames are diagnostics, not an exhaustive video-quality score.
iteration: Review full H evidence before deciding I architecture; no prewritten I training launch. I must complete400 and40/60+16. Cross-benchmark jobs deferred.
confidence: Functional checks prove implementation only; quantitative generation and actual videos determine effectiveness.

training_record_review.FM_interpretation: 单样本单步去噪；不以数值下降、大小或所谓收敛直接推断生成质量。
training_record_review.scope: 同样本/sigma/dropout配对，按阶段和sigma分层；检查目标贡献、组梯度与裁剪、阶段切换、对齐与执行的共享参数；最终结合完整评分、配对控制及真实视频。
training_record_review.causal_limit: 组梯度不是分损失梯度；当前推理消融不是训练损失消融。

loss_and_stage_design_constraint.principle: 损失函数与训练阶段保持简洁；只有明确的问题证据、作用依据和可验证贡献才调整。
loss_and_stage_design_constraint.priority: 训练日志和损失分析只是定位问题的一部分，不预设主要瓶颈就在损失或阶段划分。根据完整生成结果及配对证据，在架构、条件读取/融合、训练和推理中选择有效的实质改动。
loss_and_stage_design_constraint.avoid: 不因损失值、梯度峰值或单个诊断异常就增加损失项、阶段或繁琐调度；不以新增项数量代替效果。
loss_and_stage_design_constraint.apply_to: H结果复盘及最后一版R15I设计
